btts_and_clean_sheet#cross_tier_lambda_f.rationale: soc.cross_tier_strength_link and soc.favourite_rotation_in_mismatch now exist in the catalog inputs and are attached to handicap_and_exact_score, but neither appears in the btts_and_clean_sheet inputs or stages, so the weaker-side lambda in cross-tier cup ties has no defined source in this record; the min-lambda calibration itself is empirical.
btts_and_clean_sheet#cross_tier_lambda_f.catalog_action: Attach soc.cross_tier_strength_link and soc.favourite_rotation_in_mismatch to the btts_and_clean_sheet record (inputs list and the stage that sets each side's lambda), stating they apply to cross-division cup ties (Copa del Rey, Israeli Cup, Copa do Brasil early rounds).

btts_and_clean_sheet#fts_excess_identifi.rationale: soc.team_fail_to_score_propensity is fully defined (P0 from shot xG, excess_FTS, half-life, shrinkage n/(n+k)); what is open is whether the effect persists year over year and the shrinkage constant, an empirical-Bayes estimate on multi-season data.

btts_and_clean_sheet#own_goal_propensity.rationale: The record already states own goals are credited to the beneficiary (s5) and soc.first_goal_route_mix carries own-goal shares; the open question is whether a team-specific own-goal propensity adds anything over a league-base own-goal rate added to xG lambdas, which a regression on Understat own-goal flags settles.

competition_head_to_head#gap_coaching_sc.rationale: The catalog defines the manager-change mechanism (soc.transfers: manager-change flag with matches since change and prior/in-season rating re-blend; soc.manager_dismissal_hazard for a pending sacking), but neither is attached to competition_head_to_head, whose finish-ahead contracts span the rest of the season; the effect size itself is empirical.
competition_head_to_head#gap_coaching_sc.catalog_action: Attach soc.transfers (manager-change flag, rating re-blend) and soc.manager_dismissal_hazard to the competition_head_to_head record and its table-order stage, so a future in-window change is simulated as hazard x strength shift; leave the shift magnitude to the event study.

competition_head_to_head#h2h_three_mecha.rationale: The record already authors stages and inputs for each mechanism (tournament_joint_finish_distribution, pair_player_tournament_tally_joint, influencer_pk_duel_skill), and KXPPPKSO is NO_LISTED_MARKETS in the ledger, so nothing is unmapped; what is open is calibrating the equality and duel models on past tournaments, a data question. Re-filing into separate keys is cosmetic.

competition_winner_and_top_n#extra_time_.rationale: The 0.52-0.55 stronger-side tilt for extra time and penalties is a constant inside an already defined input (soc.bracket_path_difficulty with soc.extra_time_shootout_model); replacing it is an estimate from historical cup knockouts, not missing catalog information.

competition_winner_and_top_n#gap_coachin.rationale: soc.transfers is attached to competition_winner_and_top_n and already defines a manager-change flag with matches since change and a prior/in-season rating re-blend; what remains is the effect size of a sacking or appointment on strength, which an event study with matched controls settles.

first_half_and_period#gap_environment.rationale: soc.weather exists (heat, humidity, altitude at kickoff) but is not attached to first_half_and_period, and no interaction ties it to the 1H/2H goal split even though half variants are ~268 ledger series; this is a missing input link and interaction, with the effect size left to data.
first_half_and_period#gap_environment.catalog_action: Attach soc.weather to first_half_and_period and author an interaction soc.weather x soc.period_split (temperature/humidity/altitude shifting the second-half share of lambda) in the half-split stage, with the regression on kickoff weather named as its test.

first_half_and_period#half_dependence_ta.rationale: soc.half_level_dependence_rho and the draw-inflation term are defined and attached; whether they fit 1H exact scores above 2-1 is a backtest of log loss on half exact scores, a pure empirical question.

first_to_score_event#archetype_mismatch.rationale: Series mapping defect: the series ledger files 42 Method of Victory/Finish rows (e.g. KXUCLMOF, KXFACUPMOV, KXWCMOF, KXWCLONGESTPEN) under first_to_score_event while the catalog carries a dedicated unreg:knockout_method_of_victory record with extra-time and shootout inputs; the two records disagree on where these series are modelled.
first_to_score_event#archetype_mismatch.catalog_action: Re-map the 42 MOV/MOF ledger rows from first_to_score_event to unreg:knockout_method_of_victory (series_remap_proposals.json, then ledger), drop stages s2-s4/s7 from first_to_score_event, and confirm the knockout record's contract_review covers both MOV and MOF settlement.

first_to_score_event#inputs_unaudited_in.rationale: The missing archetype-level audit of soc.second_leg_aggregate_state, soc.extra_time_shootout_model and soc.penalty_shootout_skill falls away with the MOV/MOF re-mapping (kept as the archetype_mismatch blocker); what remains is the extra-time goal rate and first-kicker edge, both estimates from RSSSF/Wikipedia knockout records.

handicap_and_exact_score#gap_situational.rationale: Match priority enters through soc.favourite_rotation_in_mismatch (attached), which outputs a lambda multiplier that already propagates to the margin and exact-score ladder; whether priority moves the tail beyond that multiplier is an effect size measured on cup-tie margins.

match_result_3way#two_way_winner_unverif.rationale: Whether Kalshi lists any no-draw soccer winner contract (and how it treats extra time and penalties) is knowable only from Kalshi listings and rules; none of the 143 sampled soccer GAME texts is one, and the 3-way inputs are unaffected either way.

player_award#ballot_scale_panel_unverifi.rationale: Checked now (secondary sources: SI, 90min, L'Equipe totals): the Ballon d'Or Feminin jury is 50 journalists from the top-50 FIFA women's nations (47 in 2023), top-10 ballots scored 15,12,10,8,7,5,4,3,2,1, ties by most first places. The catalog's soc.panel_vote_aggregation_model scale (15,12,10,8,7,6,5,4,3,1) needs that constant corrected, but no input changes; primary regulation text not obtained.

player_award#pricing_horizon_unknown.rationale: Listing and first-trade timestamps of the PFA and EPL award series are not visible yet; they must be captured from Kalshi market lifecycle data when those series list, and the decay of availability inputs toward the ceremony is then an empirical estimate.

player_award#wc_award_selector_unverifie.rationale: Checked now: FIFA's 11-member Technical Study Group led by Arsene Wenger selected the 2026 individual awards incl. the Golden Ball (FIFA media release); exact voting mechanics are not published in what is accessible. soc.wc_award_selection_profile is a conditional logit fitted on outcomes, so the selector detail does not change the input list.

player_season_leader_and_awards#bucket_h.rationale: The record already attaches soc.player_tournament_match_exposure and soc.leader_tiebreak_and_scope, which carry the 3-8 match exposure and the dead-heat/$1/N/FIFA-tiebreak rules, and all 20 series have rules text; splitting keys is organisational, and what is open is whether pooled rate parameters calibrate across exposures.

player_season_leader_and_awards#gap_coac.rationale: Player role after a change is tracked by soc.player_xg recency weighting, soc.lineups_pit and soc.player_minutes_expectation, all attached; the claimed 20-30% shift in goals/90 after a manager change is a magnitude to estimate by event study, not a missing definition.

player_season_leader_and_awards#penalty_.rationale: soc.penalty_taker_status already defines per-player shares of team penalties over 12 months and P(taker on pitch), which yields secondary takers when the regular one is absent; succession accuracy is a backtest on historical absences.

relegation_qualification_advancement#awa.rationale: Checked now: UEFA abolished away goals in all club competitions from 2021-22; CONMEBOL from 2022 (Libertadores, Sudamericana, Recopa). The rule is already a format flag in soc.second_leg_aggregate_state/tie_advancement_state_tree, so the input list is unchanged; the per-national-cup historical regulations remain unassembled.

relegation_qualification_advancement#gap.rationale: Relegation-zone sackings are frequent, yet the record attaches neither soc.transfers (manager-change flag, rating re-blend) nor soc.manager_dismissal_hazard, so a mid-season change in the remaining-season simulation has no input; the bounce magnitude itself is empirical.
relegation_qualification_advancement#gap.catalog_action: Attach soc.manager_dismissal_hazard and soc.transfers to relegation_qualification_advancement stage s2 (remaining-fixture simulation), simulating in-season dismissals for bottom-six clubs and applying the re-blended strength after a change.

relegation_qualification_advancement#man.rationale: Duplicate of the coaching-scheme gap (kept there as the attachment blocker); what this entry adds is the contested size of the new-manager effect net of regression to the mean, which an event study with matched controls settles.

relegation_qualification_advancement#pla.rationale: The settlement includes the EFL Championship play-off route (3rd-6th, two-legged semis 3v6/4v5, single final at Wembley with extra time and penalties), but stage s3 only mentions a play-off mini-tournament; no input maps regular-season rank to promotion via that bracket (soc.playoff_format_conversion is title-only and attached elsewhere).
relegation_qualification_advancement#pla.catalog_action: Author in relegation_qualification_advancement s3 a promotion play-off bracket for KX promotion series: P(promoted)=P(top 2)+sum over ranks 3-6 of P(rank) x P(win bracket), composed from soc.tie_advancement_state_tree (two-leg semis) and soc.extra_time_shootout_model (final), or extend soc.playoff_format_conversion to promotion.

relegation_qualification_advancement#top.rationale: soc.european_slot_spillover and soc.uefa_league_phase_simulation are attached and the UEFA access list is public; what only Kalshi can settle is whether every qualification route (coefficient slot, title-holder slot, qualifying rounds) counts for KXUCLQUAL and the tie rule at the cut.

soccer_special_and_host#heterogeneous_ev.rationale: 11 of 47 series lack rules text and 'Source Agencies' is undefined in the sampled announcement texts; both need Kalshi's published rules. The record already attaches inputs for each event type (transfer_window_calendar_hazard, manager_dismissal_hazard, governance_procedure_stage, skills_challenge_format_and_field), so splitting keys is organisational.

soccer_special_and_host#host_result_seri.rationale: Series mapping defect: the ledger files KXWCHOSTWIN and KXWCHOSTKO under soccer_special_and_host, whose record models only host announcements, while the gap text places them in competition_winner_and_top_n and relegation_qualification_advancement; KXWCHOSTSTAGE is in relegation and KXWCBESTHOST is NO_LISTED_MARKETS. Ledger and records disagree.
soccer_special_and_host#host_result_seri.catalog_action: Re-map KXWCHOSTWIN to competition_winner_and_top_n and KXWCHOSTKO to relegation_qualification_advancement in the ledger (via series_remap_proposals.json), and confirm those records' stages carry host-nation advantage (soc.home_advantage) for them.

team_points_and_margin#gap_coaching_sche.rationale: team_points_and_margin attaches rotation_index and motivation but neither soc.transfers (manager-change flag, rating re-blend) nor soc.manager_dismissal_hazard, so a change during the season, which moves both the points threshold and champion margin, has no input; the size of the shift is empirical.
team_points_and_margin#gap_coaching_sche.catalog_action: Attach soc.transfers and soc.manager_dismissal_hazard to team_points_and_margin and its points_total_distribution stage, simulating in-season dismissals and re-blended strength after a change; effect size left to the event study.

team_points_and_margin#serial_correlatio.rationale: soc.latent_form_persistence is attached and fully specified (AR(1) phi of Elo residuals, mixed model with club random intercepts, cluster bootstrap); whether phi differs from zero is the estimate itself.

total_goals#gap_situational_schedule_mot.rationale: total_goals attaches no stakes or rotation input (soc.stakes_leverage, soc.motivation and soc.rotation_index are absent from its inputs and stages) although soc.motivation itself states stakes push totals; a missing input link. The sign and size are empirical (see stakes_effect_sign).
total_goals#gap_situational_schedule_mot.catalog_action: Attach soc.stakes_leverage and soc.rotation_index to the total_goals record (lambda stage), with an interaction stating dead-rubber/six-pointer leverage shifts both lambdas with unknown sign, tested by pooled residual regression.

total_goals#stakes_effect_sign.rationale: Once stakes leverage is attached (kept as the situational blocker), the remaining question is the sign and size of its effect on totals, which a pooled regression of totals residuals on leverage with league and season effects settles.

total_goals#xg_coverage_fallback.rationale: Understat xG covers six leagues only; soc.ratings already defines the goals-based alternative (Dixon-Coles on goals or ClubElo), so the input is defined and what is open is source coverage for EFL, Super Lig, Israeli, Saudi and international series; an explicit per-league coverage table is a data-readiness item.

unreg:corners_and_cards_team_events#line.rationale: soc.lineups_pit, soc.formation and soc.cross_and_wide_play_share are attached, so wide-player personnel is represented; whether starting wingers/full-backs move corners beyond team rates is a regression on lineup indicators.

unreg:knockout_method_of_victory#u2.rationale: soc.rest_travel and soc.congestion_load are attached alongside soc.extra_time_phase_scoring_rate; whether rest and load change the 90-120 scoring rate and ET-vs-penalties split is an effect size estimated on historical extra-time matches.

unreg:match_combo_parlay#u2.rationale: soc.player_minutes_expectation carries the withdrawal minute and the record names the age and days-since-last-match conditioning; what is not done is fitting the tournament/veteran substitution-minute distribution, an estimation task.

unreg:player_appearance_selection#u3.rationale: soc.pair_onpitch_overlap_model is already conditioned on matches under the same coach with both players fit, so the complement/substitute relation is coach-specific by definition; estimating it from few matches after a coach change is a sample-size question.

unreg:player_goal_assist_props#combo_and.rationale: Stage s5 with soc.first_goalscorer_race_model already defines the joint 'first non-own goal AND team wins incl. tiebreak' event for KXINTLFRIENDLYFGW, and position-mean shrinkage is a defined prior; deep-tail rungs and youth priors are calibration questions.

unreg:player_goal_assist_props#gap_situa.rationale: soc.rotation_index (attached) already takes stakes leverage and next-fixture importance as features, and soc.player_minutes_expectation carries substitution risk; how much stakes move a star's minutes is a regression on lineup history.

unreg:player_shots_saves_props#early_sub.rationale: soc.player_minutes_expectation and soc.player_shot_volume_state_response are attached and define minutes and state-dependent volume; how predictable early striker substitution is pregame is an out-of-sample hazard test on substitution logs.

unreg:player_squad_selection_and_lineup#.rationale: soc.positional_slot_competition already defines per-coach quotas Q_g from the coach's last 2 final squads with spread from 3 tournaments; the issue is estimating them from few squads, a small-sample question.

Checked now (news reports of 2026 regulations, Art. 24): outfield replacements only for serious injury/illness up to 24 h before the team's first match; injured goalkeepers replaceable throughout from the preliminary list. soc.squad_list_deadline_and_replacement_rules covers this; whether a post-first-match GK addition counts for KXWCSQUAD/CRON/MESSI is for Kalshi.

unreg:team_win_streak#u2.rationale: soc.latent_form_persistence and soc.finishing_regression are attached; whether (goals - xG) residuals autocorrelate across consecutive matches is an estimate from Understat data, not a missing input.

unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#c.rationale: soc.tournament_common_shock_factor already specifies a random-effect fit across World Cups and continental finals since 2000; the variance is poorly pinned by few tournaments, a sample-size and prior question for data analysis.

unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props#f.rationale: Checked now, but sources conflict: a betting help page states the in-progress convention (70:40 = 71st minute, so 7:30 = 8th), while a Wikipedia summary reports 32:15 recorded as the 32nd; the primary FIFA data definition could not be fetched (wikipedia host blocked). Either value only moves the 8th-minute rung, no input changes; only Kalshi/FIFA can settle the minute used.

unreg:tournament_bracket_composition#thi.rationale: Checked now: Annex C of the FIFA 2026 regulations lists all C(12,8)=495 best-third combinations into fixed R32 slots (matches 74,77,79,80,81,82,85,87); soc.bracket_slot_graph already requires transcribing it, so the input list is unchanged; the annex itself was not retrieved here.

unreg:tournament_bracket_composition#wc2.rationale: Checked now (FourFourTwo, ESPN, MLS): 2026 group ties use head-to-head points first, then overall criteria, team conduct score and FIFA ranking; best thirds use points, GD, goals, conduct, ranking. soc.group_rank_joint_distribution already encodes this order, so inputs are unchanged; the primary Article 13 text was not retrieved.
